purpose: Open the Tauri application window through tauri:dev, record WebView runtime FPS from requestAnimationFrame, and produce an app receipt.
law: 60 FPS is a measured local runtime property, not a visual claim.
Runtime FPS proof must be written by the opened Tauri WebView through the Rust bridge.
If FPS proof fails, the app must not claim AAA readiness.
Visual effects must degrade before aquarium/action visibility is degraded.
fix_reason: The runtime FPS validator matrix expects this exact filename. The previous patch wrote IMPERIUM_TAURI_RUNTIME_FPS_PROOF_CONTRACT_V0_1.json without WINDOW.
